rule: Typed row tables for procedural maps. A map asks for a template type; the type lists row numbers into one shared table; one row is picked uniformly at random. Three generators read rows: outline (island rings split by midpoint displacement with a min gap and a max push, then optional smoothing), maze (odd-sized cell grid carved by a randomised walk, with a braid chance that knocks out walls to make loops), and wave-function collapse (tiles with edge labels and per-side anti-match bitmasks; lowest-entropy cell collapsed first; tile weights squared and multiplied by a list-order ramp; contradictions reset neighbours; unsolved cells accepted after 128 resets).
